guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation page with data tables that do not overflow on narrow mobile screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing; give scrollable treatment (overflow:auto) to long unbreakable content (URLs, code) so a scrollbar appears only when content truly overflows; flex-wrap whenever overflow is possible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: wide doc-tables wrapped in .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto} preserving table semantics; baseline browser chips use flex-wrap; pre blocks keep the design-system overflow-x:auto. Verified at 390px: no document overflow.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: reports/conformance/shots/v150__sub-apps.mobile.png (local artifact, gitignored by design); chrome-devtools-mcp evaluate at 390x844 (scrollWidth=390)

guidanceConsulted.query: embed third-party iframe demo lazily without hurting page performance, with accessible title and fallback link
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Always provide a descriptive iframe title; do not disable iframe scrolling; use <caption> and th scope for data tables; use figcaption for figure content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: iframe title 'Live example — Capability & context gate (Sub apps)'; scrolling not disabled; 8/8 tables captioned with th scope (rev 2 completed the set); figure/figcaption for the embed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: a11y-tree snapshot via chrome-devtools-mcp shows Iframe node with title and full landmark structure

guidanceConsulted.query: embed third-party iframe demo lazily without hurting page performance, with accessible title and fallback link
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native loading="lazy" for below-the-fold iframes and keep explicit width/height to avoid layout shift.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: loading="lazy" with width=100% height=520 on the below-the-fold embed; network log confirms the iframe document only fetched after scroll-into-view, with zero failed requests.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: chrome-devtools-mcp network list: showcase document requested only after scrollIntoView; all requests 200/202/204

guidanceConsulted.query: long code blocks and IDL syntax blocks readable and scrollable on mobile without breaking layout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: text-wrap: balance/pretty improves ragged wrapping on short standalone text such as headings.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception, justified: h1/h2 styling is owned by the shared design system (public/styles.css) which is off-limits to per-page changes (routine safety rules); diverging on one page would break house consistency. Recorded here as a candidate design-system-level improvement.

openQuestions: LIMITATION — source volatility: a rendered chromestatus feature page can serve stale content (a 2026-07-20 render claimed shipping 153 while the direct API, updated 2026-07-24 12:57 UTC, says desktop 152 / 'Proposed'). This page's availability claims are provenanced to api/v0 responses timestamped 2026-07-24; any future run touching this page or the pending v152/sub-apps page must re-fetch the API directly — not the rendered page — and re-derive claims from whatever is current.
When the feature's status text moves off 'Proposed' (or the desktop ship estimate moves), update the banner, at-a-glance, and compat table with the new timestamped API values.
End-user platform availability is ChromeOS-only (IWA support); if IWA support expands to other desktops, update the banner, at-a-glance, and compat table.
If an Edge (or other Chromium-vendor) position is ever recorded on ChromeStatus, replace 'Not separately reported' with the recorded signal.
